metadata.description:
Every peak you've stood on tells a story — PeakNab makes sure you never lose it.

Built for serious hikers and mountaineers, PeakNab is the dedicated summit journal and progress tracker for the world's most iconic peaks. Whether you're ticking off Colorado 14ers, chasing 8000m giants, or building a lifetime list across the Alps, Andes, and Himalayas, PeakNab keeps your achievements organized and your ambitions in sight.

Browse a curated database of 100+ peaks spanning seven iconic categories: the Seven Summits, 8000m peaks, Colorado 14ers, the Alps, Andes, Himalayas, and beyond. Search by name, explore by range, and discover summits still waiting for your footsteps.

Log each achievement the way it deserves. Record the date, attach a summit photo, and write a personal report while the details are still fresh. PeakNab supports multiple summit entries per mountain, so every return trip gets its own dedicated record — because no two ascents are ever the same.

Your climber profile tracks the full picture: total summits logged, elevation gained, countries visited, and mountain ranges explored. Animated category progress bars show exactly how close you are to completing the Seven Summits or finishing every 14er — clear, motivating, and always up to date.

The interactive O₂ equivalent altitude reference chart gives you a tool every mountaineer should have on hand. Understand what your body is working with at any elevation, from base camp to the highest summits on earth.

Not every great mountain makes a curated list. PeakNab lets you add your own peaks with a custom name, elevation, GPS coordinates, and difficulty rating — logged and tracked exactly like any other summit in the database.

Sign in to enable cloud sync across all your devices and export your complete summit log as a polished PDF. A permanent, portable record of every mountain you've climbed, ready to share or keep for life.

Download PeakNab and start building the summit log your climbs deserve.
metadata.subtitle: Track Every Summit
metadata.promotionalText: Log every summit. Track your progress from 14ers to 8000m giants. Cloud sync, PDF export & 100+ peaks included. Download PeakNab today.
